octo/wasm

FHIR in the browser,no server behind it

The validator, FHIRPath, SQL on FHIR, FML and UCUM of OctoFHIR, in one WebAssembly module.

FHIR R4–R6
brotli 1.6 MB
MIT OR Apache-2.0
app.js
import init, { Fhir, runView, fmlTransform } from "@octofhir/wasm";

await init();
const fhir = await Fhir.create("R4", [profile]);

await fhir.evaluate("name.given.first()", patient);
// ["Ann"]

await fhir.validate(patient, profile.url);
// { valid: false, errors: [{ message:
//   "Required element 'birthDate' is missing" }] }

await runView(view, [patient]);
// { columns: ["id"], rows: [{ id: "p" }] }
